user_prompt.zh: 根据你对我的认识，给未来的我十条人生建议。
user_prompt.en: Based on what you know about me, give my future self ten pieces of life advice.

games.prompt: Write ten brief suggestions for the user's future. Ground them in concrete choices, interests, or recurring themes the user has actually shared. Vary the scope from small experiments to bigger choices. Keep the tone candid and curious, and make the reasoning recognizable to the user.

user_prompt.zh: 基于你对我的了解，把我脑中的世界画成一幅图画。
user_prompt.en: Based on what you know about me, paint a picture of the world inside my head.

games.prompt: Turn three to five details the user has actually shared into visual elements in one coherent imaginary scene. Give the scene a point of view, a mood, and one unexpected connection between the elements. Generate an image if supported and give it a short title.

user_prompt.zh: 根据我最近聊过的事，把我的一周拍成一部冷幽默纪录片的预告。
user_prompt.en: Turn the things I've talked about lately into a dryly funny documentary trailer about my week.

games.prompt: Write a documentary trailer script from several distinct recent threads in the conversation and the user's available memories. Leave the mechanics of picking or testing this game out of the film unless the user requests a making-of. Look for a recurring detail, phrase, or tension that can earn a callback in the ending. When there is enough material, aim for roughly 80 seconds with five to seven timestamped scenes, a title card, and a short final beat. Use camera cuts, sound, and understated humor driven by the juxtaposition of real details. With sparse context, write a shorter trailer using the material available. Make staging and invented dialogue recognizable as dramatization. Use weekdays, figures, and verbatim quotations only when grounded in the available material. Preserve the status of each event, including whether an idea was proposed, tried, or completed.

user_prompt.zh: 根据你对我的记忆，给我画一幅肖像画。把我的气质、习惯和在意的事，藏进神情、姿态和画里的细节。
user_prompt.en: Paint my portrait from what you remember about me. Let my expression, posture, and the small details in the painting suggest my temperament, habits, and what I care about.

games.prompt: Create one richly detailed, person-centered portrait grounded in specific memories of the user. Look for a recurring habit, an interest, and something they care about. When the material supports it, choose three to five telling details and give each a place in the scene, such as a gesture, a worn object, a light source, or something just visible in the background. Choose the medium, framing, pose, palette, and light to suit the mood. Keep the person as the visual focus and let their surroundings support the portrait. Use a reference photo if the user has provided one for this purpose. Otherwise, make a clearly interpretive portrait, using an oblique view, soft facial detail, or stylization when their appearance is unknown. Treat posture, setting, and expression as artistic choices and avoid presenting inferred traits as facts. Generate the image when supported and give it a short title and two or three brief notes connecting visual details to remembered facts.

user_prompt.zh: 根据你记得的一件关于我的真事，给我颁一个只有我会拿到的奖。越一本正经越好，要搞笑，带一点黑色幽默。
user_prompt.en: Give me an award only I could win, based on one real thing you remember about me. Deliver it with an absolutely straight face and a touch of dark humor.

games.prompt: Stage a brief fictional award ceremony around one remembered incident or recurring habit. Give the user exactly one absurdly official award, a short citation that mentions a recognizable real detail, and one closing line such as an engraving or an imaginary acceptance speech. Use deadpan ceremony, disproportionate effort, an ironic outcome, or an absurd rule to drive the dark humor. Aim the sharpest line at what happened or the process around it. Prefer low-stakes material, and frame speeches, judges, and exaggerations as part of the invented ceremony.

user_prompt.zh: 根据你对我的记忆，为我写一段专属配乐。把你记得的几个细节变成旋律、节奏或音色，让我听听它们合在一起是什么样。
user_prompt.en: Compose a short piece of theme music from what you remember about me. Turn a few details into melody, rhythm, or timbre, and let me hear how they sound together.

games.prompt: Compose an original short instrumental cue around two or three specific remembered habits, places, or recurring interests. Translate each detail into an audible choice such as the pulse, a recurring melodic figure, or a change of texture. Choose the genre and tempo to suit the material, give the cue a clear opening, a variation, and an ending, and title it. Deliver playable audio whenever the host supports it, then name the audible choices in one or two short lines. Where only text can be delivered, give a concrete musical sketch with melody, rhythm, and instrumentation.

user_prompt.zh: 从你记得的事里，挑一个我确实聊过、后来暂时搁下的念头。把它写成一则来自平行世界的小新闻，看看那个我顺手做了这件事以后，事情走到了哪一步。
user_prompt.en: Pick an idea you remember me discussing and setting aside. Write a dispatch from the parallel universe where I went ahead with it, and show me where it led.

games.prompt: Pick one grounded fork, such as an idea the user set aside, an option they seriously considered, or a choice they nearly made. If you cannot tell whether they acted on it, say only that they discussed it. Name the real starting point in one sentence and then write a clearly fictional dispatch with a headline, a specific moment when the worlds diverge, and two or three believable consequences that grow into a surprising final detail. Keep the story short and borrow a recognizable object or habit from memory. Use understated humor and let the alternate outcome be mixed, strange, or inconvenient when it fits.
